rubric.evidence: models/mms-forced-alignment/worker.js runs the REAL Wav2Vec2ForCTC model (onnx-community/mms-300m-1130-forced-aligner-ONNX, WASM q4) directly via AutoModelForCTC — the ASR pipeline is deliberately NOT used because it hides the per-frame logits. dtype VERIFIED LIVE in headless Chrome 2026-08-04: q4 session creates + forward returns logits [1,49,31] (MatMulNBits has a WASM kernel); int8/q8 exports fail session creation with ERROR_CODE 9 'Could not find an implementation for ConvInteger' (fail-closed, recorded on page + models.json). Alignment = argmax per frame → emission strip → monotonic transcript-frame matching (mirrors the reference ctc-forced-aligner algorithm).

align() takes a 16kHz mono Float32Array + transcript → { words:[{text,start,end}], transcript, heard, frames, frameMs, matched, total, ms, device }. Semantic sanity = word timestamps monotonic and landing on the actual words — pending the live headless-Chrome run on the JFK sample.

At-a-glance declares exact source id onnx-community/mms-300m-1130-forced-aligner-ONNX (linked) + original MahmoudAshraf model, task automatic-speech-recognition (used for forced alignment), architecture Wav2Vec2ForCTC (MMS-300m backbone, 31-symbol alphabet), dtype q4 (with the honest note that the int8 export has no WASM ConvInteger kernel), backend WASM, size ~241MB, license CC-BY-NC-4.0 (recorded honestly), web APIs. model-loader entry matches (dtype q4 sizeMB 241).
Uses lib/model-loader.js createModelLoader (shared auto-init; Download only when absent; Update/Re-download/Clear per state). No bespoke Load button.

status line surfaces checking→initialising→ready via the loader; Aligning…/Aligned./Alignment failed: <message> with .err styling; worker errors propagate; retry = re-run. Upload dropzone has drag states; audio player; offline/eviction handled by the shared loader.

Dropzone (click + keyboard), file input, sample chip, transcript textarea, Align button, clickable word chips (buttons), audio player. Native controls; status role=status aria-live; word chips keyboard-accessible.

Every timestamp comes from the model's real per-frame argmax + monotonic matching of the user's transcript. The 'what the model heard' panel shows the honest greedy CTC reading separately — never passed off as the alignment.

Design-system classes only; native controls; word chips are buttons with visible timestamps; live region on status. Sub-24px tap targets likely on word chips/sliders — flagged for the responsive matrix pass.
Uses the shared design system's responsive grid; word chips wrap; audio element is full-width. Full 360x740 + 1280x800 matrix with real runs pending. support=needs-review on both classes until then.
All inference (forward pass + argmax + matching) runs in the Web Worker; audio decode/resample via Web Audio (OfflineAudioContext) is a short main-thread step. WASM int8 317MB is a moderate download.

summary: Revision-1 critique for mms-forced-alignment (onnx-community/mms-300m-1130-forced-aligner-ONNX, automatic-speech-recognition/CTC, Transformers.js, WASM q4, ~241MB, CC-BY-NC-4.0). NEW CAPABILITY: forced alignment — the first word-timestamp demo on the showcase. Direct AutoModelForCTC call (q4 — the int8/q8 exports' ConvInteger op has no WASM kernel; verified fail-closed) (no pipeline) + the reference ctc-forced-aligner algorithm (normalize → char ids with space label 3 → CTC collapse → monotonic match → word spans at frame×20ms). Bundled public-domain JFK sample with transcript + media/manifest.json provenance. 3 use-case rungs: basics (word timestamps), practical (SRT export), wild (record-your-voice alignment via mic). GENUINE OPEN ITEMS: live inference verification pending, support=needs-review until responsive matrix pass.
